data.one_liner: Flutter library with 50+ professional color filters and 95+ film, cinema, and artistic presets.
data.what_it_does: Provides a collection of matrix-based color filters and presets for Flutter applications, ranging from basic brightness adjustments to film emulation, cinema looks, and technical corrections.
use_when: You want to apply Instagram or Lightroom-style filters to images in your Flutter app.
You need film emulation stocks like Kodak or Fuji in a pure Flutter implementation.
avoid_when: You need advanced pixel-level image manipulation, cropping, or editing tools rather than color filters.
You are targeting Flutter versions older than 3.10.0.
strengths: Zero dependencies with a pure Flutter implementation.
Extensive collection of 50+ filters and 95+ presets.
Optimized matrix-based performance for real-time filtering.
weaknesses: Limited to color filtering and adjustments rather than broader image editing capabilities.

alternatives.name: image
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need deeper programmatic image manipulation, decoding, encoding, and filtering directly on raw image data rather than Flutter widget tree filters.
